source.title: Synthetic QA manual: Record uniqueness / 模型记录唯一性
source.locator: 合成 QA 手册 §1 · 数据唯一性
source.text:
模型分配按楼层 + 工况唯一，反力按支座 + 工况唯一；记录 ID 也须唯一。
Formula: count(unique keys) = count(records).
Required evidence: 非空模型记录.
Scope: unfactored static gravity, SDL and LIVE only, self-weight excluded, upward reaction positive. Numerical comparisons use the fixed demonstration tolerance max(1 kN, 1% of the absolute expected value). These are synthetic demonstration rules, not an Australian Standard or structural design approval.

source.title: Synthetic QA manual: Floor and load-case coverage / 楼层与荷载工况覆盖
source.locator: 合成 QA 手册 §2 · 覆盖范围
source.text:
每个独立任务书要求，都有对应的模型分配；不能遗漏或额外增加楼层/工况。
Formula: model keys = brief keys.
Required evidence: 独立任务书及完整楼层清单.
Scope: unfactored static gravity, SDL and LIVE only, self-weight excluded, upward reaction positive. Numerical comparisons use the fixed demonstration tolerance max(1 kN, 1% of the absolute expected value). These are synthetic demonstration rules, not an Australian Standard or structural design approval.

source.title: Synthetic QA manual: Floor load distribution / 分层荷载分配
source.locator: 合成 QA 手册 §3 · 分层分配
source.text:
逐楼层、逐工况比较模型分配力与任务书的面积 × 荷载强度。总量相同不能替代分层检查。
Formula: Fexpected = Abrief × qbrief.
Required evidence: 独立面积、荷载强度、模型分配及其证据.
Scope: unfactored static gravity, SDL and LIVE only, self-weight excluded, upward reaction positive. Numerical comparisons use the fixed demonstration tolerance max(1 kN, 1% of the absolute expected value). These are synthetic demonstration rules, not an Australian Standard or structural design approval.

source.title: Synthetic QA manual: Load-case totals / 各工况荷载总量
source.locator: 合成 QA 手册 §4 · 荷载总量
source.text:
SDL 与 LIVE 分别汇总，不允许跨工况抵消；重复分配阻断总量判断。
Formula: Σ Fmodel ≈ Σ (Abrief × qbrief).
Required evidence: 唯一且完整的荷载分配、独立任务书.
Scope: unfactored static gravity, SDL and LIVE only, self-weight excluded, upward reaction positive. Numerical comparisons use the fixed demonstration tolerance max(1 kN, 1% of the absolute expected value). These are synthetic demonstration rules, not an Australian Standard or structural design approval.

source.title: Synthetic QA manual: Independent vertical reaction balance / 独立竖向反力核对
source.locator: 合成 QA 手册 §5 · 独立反力
source.text:
独立导出反力的向上幅值，逐工况与任务书预期的向下荷载幅值比较。仅附加恒载及活载，无自重与组合。
Formula: Σ Rz,export ≈ Σ (Abrief × qbrief).
Required evidence: 同一范围的反力结果、支座清单、独立任务书.
Scope: unfactored static gravity, SDL and LIVE only, self-weight excluded, upward reaction positive. Numerical comparisons use the fixed demonstration tolerance max(1 kN, 1% of the absolute expected value). These are synthetic demonstration rules, not an Australian Standard or structural design approval.

source.title: Synthetic QA manual: Evidence completeness / 证据与资料完整性
source.locator: 合成 QA 手册 §6 · 证据完整性
source.text:
每个工程数值都必须关联有内容和定位的证据记录，且具备任务书、模型分配表、反力结果、审核说明。
Formula: required evidence ⊆ supplied evidence.
Required evidence: 内容非空的证据条目及来源定位.
Scope: unfactored static gravity, SDL and LIVE only, self-weight excluded, upward reaction positive. Numerical comparisons use the fixed demonstration tolerance max(1 kN, 1% of the absolute expected value). These are synthetic demonstration rules, not an Australian Standard or structural design approval.

source.title: Synthetic linear-static combination response reconciliation
source.text: For linear-static responses in kN, calculate the expected response as the sum of each supplied factor multiplied by its independently supplied base-case response. Compare the separately supplied reported response with expected ± max(1 kN, 1% of abs(expected)); endpoints are included. Missing base cases, missing separate source evidence, empty terms, unsupported analysis or arithmetic failure produce NOT VERIFIED. The shipped examples are C1 = 1.2 SDL + 1.5 LIVE and C2 = SDL - LIVE. These chosen factors are synthetic examples, not an AS 1170 rule. The same calculation method may check other explicitly supplied combination IDs within the tool contract; this does not approve their factors or establish structural safety.
